# 1 - Setup

```{r, setup, include=FALSE}

options(scipen=999)

pacman::p_load(
  data.table,
  tidycensus,
  mapcdatakeys,
  tidyverse,
  arrow,
  here
)

# File paths
# Paths
if (grepl('VM',Sys.info()[['nodename']])){
  base <- '//data-sync/Public/DataServices/Projects/Current_Projects/'
} else {
  base <- 'S:/Network Shares/K Drive/DataServices/Projects/Current_Projects/'
}

root <- paste0(base,'Projections/Projections_2028/Data/01_Regional_Control_Totals/')

urb.path <- paste0(root,'UrbanSim_base_pop/')
raw.path <- paste0(urb.path,'ma_state_base_data_2010_2020_v20261005/')

shop.path <- paste0(base,'Housing/StatewideHousingPlan/04_Analysis/Data/Working/Regional_Control_Totals/')

# PUMS vintage
vintage <- 2023

# RPA names
mpos <- mapcdatakeys::all_muni_data_keys |> 
  pull(mpo) |> 
  unique()

# Munis by RPA/MPO
munis <- all_muni_data_keys |> 
  select(muni_id, rpa_acr, mpo) |> 
  setDT()

# 2020 Blocks / Munis / RPA / MPO
blks <- geog_xw_2020 |> 
  left_join(munis, by = 'muni_id') |> 
  select(bl20_id, muni_id, muni_name, rpa_acr, mpo) |> 
  mutate(block_id = as.character(bl20_id)) |> 
  setDT()

source(here('scripts/Projections.Functions.R'))

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
```

# 2 - Raw PUMS data

```{r}


# Load 2023 PUMS data

pums_vars_2023 <- c(
  "SERIALNO",
  "WGTP",
  "PWGTP",
  "PUMA",
  "TYPEHUGQ",
  "TEN",
  "BLD",
  "SPORDER",
  "AGEP",
  "ESR",
  "PINCP",
  "HINCP",
  "ADJINC"
  )

pums <- get_pums(
  state = 'MA',
  year = vintage,
  survey = 'acs5',
  variables = pums_vars_2023
) |> 
  filter(TYPEHUGQ==1)

saveRDS(pums, file.path(root,'PUMS',paste0('pums_',vintage,'_basic.rds')))

```

# 3 - Join to PUMS and create new variables

NOTE: We use the CPI deflator time series to adjust PUMS income to 2013 dollars (for UrbanSim). ACS uses the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers Retroactive Series (R-CPI-U-RS, details here: <https://www.bls.gov/cpi/research-series/r-cpi-u-rs-home.htm>) as opposed to the ASEC/Census which uses C-CPI-U (details here: [*https://www.census.gov/topics/income-poverty/income/guidance/current-vs-constant-dollars.html*](https://www.census.gov/topics/income-poverty/income/guidance/current-vs-constant-dollars.html){.uri}*)*

```{r}

pums <- readRDS(file.path(root,'PUMS',paste0('pums_',vintage,'_basic.rds')))

pop <- arrow::open_dataset(paste0(raw.path,'ma_state_base_data_2020_persons.parquet')) |> 
  collect() |> 
  setDT()

hh <- arrow::open_dataset(paste0(raw.path,'ma_state_base_data_2020_households.parquet')) |> 
  collect() |> 
  setDT()

# Load CPI time series for deflating income variable
# Deflate to 2013 dollars to match old model spec

cpi <- fread(paste0(root,'cpi_deflators_by_year.csv'))
cpi.deflator <- cpi[year==2013, index] / cpi[year==vintage, index]

pums_data <- pums |> 
  mutate(
    # Generate five-year age groupings to match UMDI population projections data.
    AgeCat = cut(AGEP, breaks = c(-Inf, seq(4, 84, 5), Inf), labels = 1:18),
    ADJINC = as.numeric(ADJINC),
    # clean negative personal incomes
    PINCP = case_when(
      PINCP<0 ~ 0,
      .default = PINCP)
  ) |> 
  # recalculate household incomes
    group_by(SERIALNO) |> 
    mutate(HINCP = sum(PINCP)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  # Adjust income first to the highest year in the 5-year vintage using included adjustment field (ADJINC)
  # For UrbanSim we then deflate back to 2013, using the cpi deflator 
  mutate(
    HINCP2013 = round((as.numeric(HINCP) * ADJINC) * cpi.deflator, 0),
    hh_income_group =
      cut(
        HINCP,
        breaks = c(-Inf, 35000, 75000, 125000, 225000, Inf),
        labels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5")
      ),
    tenure = case_when(
      TEN %in% c('1','2') ~ 1,
      TEN %in% c('3','4') ~ 2
    ),
    # Categorizing Civilian Labor Force or not
    # NOTE: Categories are (0) under 16 or non-civilian, (1) in labor force, (2) not in labor force
    lf = case_when(
      ESR == "b" | ESR == 4 | ESR == 5  ~ 0,
      ESR == 1 | ESR == 2 | ESR == 3  ~ 1,
      ESR == 6 ~ 2,
      is.na(ESR) ~ 0
    ),
    # Counts as Worker
    # NOTE: Categories are (0) under 16 or not in labor force, or (1) in labor force or non-civilian worker
    worker = case_when(
      (ESR == "b" | ESR == 6) ~ 0,
      (ESR == 1 | ESR == 2 | ESR == 3 | ESR == 4 | ESR == 5) ~ 1,
      is.na(ESR) ~ 0
    ),
    # Determine if case counts as child
    child = case_when(
      AGEP < 18 ~ 1,
      AGEP >= 18 ~ 0
      ),
    adult = case_when(
      child == 1 ~ 0,
      child == 0 ~ 1
    )
  ) |> 
  #Generating Household Variables
  group_by(SERIALNO) |> 
  mutate(
    workers = sum(worker),
    persons = max(SPORDER),
    children = sum(child),
    adults = sum(adult)
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  # Categorizing household sizes by number of persons (1) one person, (2) two persons, (3) three persons, (4) four or more persons
  mutate(
    HHSize = case_when(
      persons == 1 ~ 1,
      persons == 2 ~ 2,
      persons == 3 ~ 3,
      persons >= 4 ~ 4
    ),
    # Determine type of household (1) hh with children, (3) multiple adults no children, (5) single
    HHtype = case_when(
      children > 0 & persons > 1 ~ 1,
      children == 0 & persons > 1 ~ 3,
      persons == 1 ~ 5
    ),
    pid = paste0(SERIALNO,'_',SPORDER)
  ) |> 
  setDT()

# join additional PUMS fields to UrbanSim 2020 base year micropopulation

urbsim_pums <- left_join(pop |> select(-AGEP), pums_data, by = c('SERIALNO', 'SPORDER')) |>
  select(-WGTP, -PWGTP) |> 
  left_join(hh |> select(SERIALNO, income, age_of_head, hh_children_present, hh_type) |> unique(),
    by = c('SERIALNO')
  ) |>
  setDT()
fwrite(urbsim_pums, paste0(urb.path,'UrbanSim_2020_baseyear_micropop_with_PUMS_vars.csv'))


# Create PUMA to RPA/MPO Crosswalk for 2020 PUMAs

xw97 <- mapcdatakeys::puma_muni_xw_2020 |> 
  left_join(munis, by='muni_id') |> 
  group_by(mpo, PUMACE20) |> 
  summarise(
    mpo_overlap_m2 = sum(overlap_m2)
         ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(mpo_overlap_m2 > 1e6) |> 
  select(PUMACE20, mpo) |> 
  unique() |> 
  rename(PUMA=PUMACE20) |> 
  mutate(PUMA = as.numeric(PUMA))

# Subset of PUMS SERIALNOs represented in urbansim base year micropop
pums_sampling_domain97 <- pums_data |> 
  mutate(pid = paste0(SERIALNO, '_', SPORDER),
         PUMA = as.numeric(PUMA)) |> 
  filter(pid %in% urbsim_pums$pid) |> 
  left_join(xw97, by='PUMA') |> 
  setDT()

fwrite(pums_sampling_domain97, paste0(root, 'PUMS/pums_',vintage,'_urbansim_baseline_MAPC97.csv'))

xw101 <- mapcdatakeys::puma_muni_xw_2020 |> 
  left_join(munis, by='muni_id') |> 
  group_by(rpa_acr, PUMACE20) |> 
  summarise(
    rpa_overlap_m2 = sum(overlap_m2)
         ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(rpa_overlap_m2 > 1e6) |> 
  select(PUMACE20, rpa_acr) |> 
  unique() |> 
  rename(PUMA=PUMACE20) |> 
  mutate(PUMA = as.numeric(PUMA))

pums_sampling_domain101 <- pums_data |> 
  mutate(pid = paste0(SERIALNO, '_', SPORDER),
         PUMA = as.numeric(PUMA)) |> 
  filter(pid %in% urbsim_pums$pid) |> 
  left_join(xw101, by='PUMA') |> 
  setDT()

fwrite(pums_sampling_domain101, paste0(root, 'PUMS/pums_',vintage,'_urbansim_baseline_MAPC101.csv'))
```
